title: yuandao（缘之道）
description: A Taoist-style Minecraft mod adding talismans, artifacts, and spirit summoning systems. Draw talismans with AI recognition!
body:
# Yuandao

A Taoist-style Minecraft mod that adds talisman drawing, spell charms, magical artifacts, and a summoning system.

- **If you have any great new ideas, please email them to 1785655495@qq.com**

## Main Features

### Talisman System
- **Thunder Talisman**: Summons lightning to attack enemies, **4 tiers** (Lower / Medium / Upper / Supreme)
- **Wind Cloud Talisman**: Explosive knockback effect, speed boost
- **Immobilization Talisman**: Freezes mobs and players in place
(**In development...** ideas welcome!)

### Artifacts
- **Demon-Reflecting Mirror**: Special attack against undead, damage affected by **time, weather, and light**
- **Soul-Summoning Banner**: Consumes Soul Dust to summon Spirit Talismans to assist in combat

### Talisman Crafting Table
- **Hand-drawn talisman interface**
- **AI-powered recognition** of talisman type and tier
- Support for **Volcano Engine API** configuration

### Raw Materials
- **Cinnabar Ore** → **Cinnabar** → Consumable for talisman drawing
- Undead mobs drop **Soul Essence** → Craft into **Soul Dust**

## How to Play

1. **AI Configuration**:
   - Register and verify at: （https://www.volcengine.com/product/ark）
2. ![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9cc4ebd88a3b625f44d0d4636e2da4c463f490db_0.webp)
   - Create an **API Key** in the API Key Management section![2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ef22a7e8a7ba9fb95c4bec0bd2d99d4b5cc25b5_0.webp)
   - Enable a model with vision capabilities (recommended: doubao-seed-1-8-251228)![3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6bcc8e7d76be5356d6c5894713c6b07b8b1f46c5.png)
   - In-game, press **O** and enter the URL, API Key, and model

2. Open the **Talisman Crafting Table**, place a **Blank Talisman** and **Cinnabar** in the slots
   - Click **Pick Color**, then draw on the canvas
   - Click **Craft** and wait for the AI to process

3. Defeat undead mobs to obtain **Soul Essence**
   - Combine with Bone Meal to craft **Soul Dust**
   - Use Soul Dust to fuel the **Soul-Summoning Banner**
   - Right-click the banner with **Red** (high damage), **Blue** (high attack speed), or **Green** (healing) Spirit Talismans to summon spirit helpers

## Supported Versions

- **Minecraft 1.20.1**
- **Forge 47.4.0+**

## Multiplayer Support

The mod supports multiplayer, but **AI configuration** must be set up individually by each player.

## Credits

- **Volcano Engine** for providing the Doubao large model API


# 缘之符
（有新的可行性建议请投至1785655495@qq.com）

一个道教风格的 Minecraft 模组，添加了画符、符咒、法器和召唤系统。

## 主要功能

### 符咒系统
- **天雷符**：召唤雷电攻击敌人，4个品阶（下品/中品/上品/极品）
- **风云符**：爆炸击退效果，速度增益
- **定身符**：定住生物玩家等 
（开发中……欢迎提供灵感）
### 法器
- **照妖镜**：对亡灵特攻，伤害受时间、天气、光照影响
- **招魂幡**：消耗魂尘召唤符灵协助战斗

### 制符台
- 手绘画符界面
- AI智能识别符箓类型和品阶
- 支持火山引擎API配置

### 原材料
- 辰砂矿石 → 朱砂 → 画符消耗品
- 击杀亡灵掉落魂质 → 合成魂尘

## 玩法说明

1、AI配置：
在
（https://www.volcengine.com/product/ark）
中注册账号完成认证，打开控制台![网站界面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9cc4ebd88a3b625f44d0d4636e2da4c463f490db_0.webp)
在左边API KEY管理创建一个APIKEY，并于开通管理中开通一个具有视觉功能的模型（推荐doubao-seed-1-8-251228）![配置界面](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ef22a7e8a7ba9fb95c4bec0bd2d99d4b5cc25b5_0.webp)
在游戏中按O输入对应的URL（默认）、APIKEY以及模型（推荐doubao-seed-1-8-251228）![模型](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6bcc8e7d76be5356d6c5894713c6b07b8b1f46c5.png)
2、打开制符台方块右键互动，分别在槽中放入空符与朱砂，点击取色后作画，点击制符等待感应
3、击败亡灵生物掉落魂质，与骨粉合成魂尘后为招魂幡注入灵魂，用赤灵符（高伤害）、青灵符（高攻速）、翠灵符（给予回复生命）右键招魂幡召唤符灵

## 支持版本

- Minecraft 1.20.1
- Forge 47.4.0+

## 联机支持

模组支持多人联机，但 AI 配置需要每个玩家单独填写。

## 致谢

- 火山引擎 提供豆包大模型 API
